name: Check Engine
definition: Indicates a fault detected by the engine control module (ECM/PCM). May be emissions-related or a serious engine problem. Read codes before clearing.
causes: Spark plug or ignition coil failure
solutions: Read OBD-II codes with a scanner and note freeze-frame
Tighten or replace the gas cap if EVAP codes present
Address ignition, fuel, and sensor faults from the code list
Do not clear codes until the repair is verified
urgencyNote: Flashing light = reduce load and diagnose soon (misfire risk to catalytic converter).

faq.question: Can I drive with the check engine light on?
faq.answer: Often yes if the light is steady and the car runs normally. A flashing light means active misfire risk—ease off and diagnose promptly.

faq.question: Should I clear the light without fixing anything?
faq.answer: No. Capture the code first. Clearing alone does not repair the fault and can reset emissions readiness.
